name: Return Arrow
body:
When you grab an opponent’s arrow from the air – and if you have a bow in hand – you may immediately fire it.

Prerequisite(s): Dexterity 18, Snatch Arrows

Benefit: As long as you have a bow in hand, you may immediately fire a snatched arrow back at the attacker at a –2 attack penalty. This is a free action.
